data.text/markdown:
From a fitted pipeline to a reusable artifact

Binary probabilities · explicit tuning · sklearn · immutable prediction state This notebook follows one complete experiment: compose preprocessing, fit a classifier, inspect held-out probabilities, select weights on training-only folds, and save a versioned predictor. It also shows the deliberate boundary between invalid input exceptions and unsuccessful numerical fits. The default run is offline and seeded. It fits a small model and verifies artifact and sklearn round trips. Hyperparameter search is an explicit, separately submitted operation; the final test snapshot is never used to select its weights.

data.text/html:
result = fit(recipe, X_train, y_train, solver=ADMM())
match result:
    case FitSuccess(predictor=classifier, diagnostics=info):
        probabilities = classifier.predict_proba(X_test)
        save_artifact(classifier, 'artifacts/classifier')
        restored = load_binary_classifier('artifacts/classifier')
    case FitFailure(reason=reason, diagnostics=info):
        report_failure(reason, info)
The task-specific loader returns a classifier with its probability interface. The workflow below executes these operations using a temporary artifact directory.

Inspect probabilities, not only classification accuracy

Log loss and Brier score evaluate probabilities. ROC AUC and average precision evaluate ranking. A probability model can rank observations well and still be poorly calibrated; these are separate questions.

Decision thresholds do not require refitting

Move this threshold to see decision counts change while fitted probabilities remain fixed. Choose an operational threshold using validation data and application costs, not by optimizing this final test plot.

Optional tuning is an explicit experiment

The search receives raw train/validation sources. Every fold fits its own standardizer and owns a separate warm-start session. Numerical caches can be shared only when their dependencies match. The metric pools all validation rows; unequal fold sizes are not silently averaged. A failed numerical trial is reported.
<marimo-callout-output data-html='"<span>No search has been run. The default model above uses its explicitly supplied weights.</span>"' data-kind='"neutral"'></marimo-callout-output>

sklearn compatibility is a separate adapter

The adapter follows sklearn's mutable fit convention and maps arbitrary binary labels to the native zero/one task. The recipe and fitted native predictor remain immutable. clone creates an independent estimator; it does not share fitted preprocessing.

A fitted predictor is a portable prediction artifact

The directory contains a versioned JSON manifest and numerical arrays. It records feature/axis order and fitted transform parameters. Task-specific loading returns a classifier, preserving its typed probability interface. Sources, training rows, caches, and warm starts are not part of this inference artifact.
{
  "format": "stratified-models-predictor",
  "version": 1,
  "task": "binary",
  "weights": {
    "sparsity": 0.004,
    "shrinkage": 0.02,
    "smoothing": 0.01
  },
  "array metadata": {
    "coefficients": {
      "shape": [
        5,
        3
      ],
      "dtype": "<f8"
    },
    "array_1": {
      "shape": [
        2
      ],
      "dtype": "<f8"
    },
    "array_2": {
      "shape": [
        2
      ],
      "dtype": "<f8"
    }
  },
  "payload checksum verified": true,
  "maximum probability round-trip error": 0.0
}

External components compose and serialize explicitly

OffsetFeature is a tiny external fitted-transform implementation: it shifts one column and preserves rows and targets. It participates through the transform protocol without inheriting a library class. Its codec stores only a column name and finite offset. Loading requires the explicitly supplied registry; artifact metadata does not import or install executable components.

Errors and unsuccessful solves have different contracts

Invalid configuration, schema, data, or replay raises a specific exception as soon as it is encountered. A valid optimization that exhausts its budget returns the typed failure branch with diagnostics. Neither path silently returns a plausible-looking successful model.
